description.en: You duck through a low opening into a surprisingly roomy cave behind Crane Peak.
description.zh-CN: 你弯身走进华山后山的一个山洞中，原来此处别有洞天，内部空间极为开阔。

description.en: A small cave behind Crane Peak.
description.zh-CN: 华山后方的一个小山洞。

description.en: Nephthys keeps a quiet vigil in the cave. She would rather not be interrupted.
description.zh-CN: 奈芙蒂斯在洞中静静守夜，不希望被打扰。

击败何红药，得到五毒教信物。.en: Faced Nephthys's wrath and received a Venom Circle Token.
击败何红药，得到五毒教信物。.zh-CN: 应对了奈芙蒂斯的怒火，获得一枚毒环信物。

text.en: Osiris rules the underworld now. I still catch myself listening for his footsteps.
text.zh-CN: 奥西里斯如今统治冥界。我却还是忍不住，想听见他的脚步声。

text.en: My brother. Isis is my sister, and Horus is her son. Grief is practically a family business.
text.zh-CN: 他是我兄弟。伊西斯是我姐妹，荷鲁斯是她的儿子。我们家简直把哀悼做成了家业。

text.en: That sounds like a difficult line of work.
text.zh-CN: 这份家业，听起来不太好做。

text.en: Especially when visitors mistake a quiet vigil for an invitation to chat.
text.zh-CN: 尤其是访客总把安静守夜，当成欢迎闲聊的邀请。

text.en: Yes. Even the dead deserve a little privacy.
text.zh-CN: 是的。就连亡者，也该有点清静。

text.en: I asked for quiet, traveler. Stay, and you'll meet the less welcoming side of a guardian.
text.zh-CN: 旅人，我已经请你给我一点清静。再留下，就得见识守护者不怎么好客的一面了。

text.en: Then defend yourself. The dead are under my protection.
text.zh-CN: 那就准备自保吧。亡者由我守护。

text.en: Keep the token. I return to Osiris in the Duat. You still have a life to get on with.
text.zh-CN: 信物留给你。我该回冥界去见奥西里斯了。你在人间还有自己的路要走。

text.en: I'll try to spend less of it arguing with gods.
text.zh-CN: 我争取少花点时间，和神明争论。

text.en: A Venom Circle Token. Maybe the next gatekeeper will be easier to talk to.
text.zh-CN: 一枚毒环信物。希望下一个守门人，能好说话些。
